geometry_sampling_note: Stable instance fraction applies only where geometry seeds produce distinct instances. Fixed-parameter Flat, regular Slope, and regular Stairs are repeated trials on identical geometry; do not count those as independent geometry instances.
lock_rule: numeric cutoffs require review after runtime qualification and are not execution authorization

sample_count_and_uncertainty.interval_method: Wilson score interval for binary completion outcomes; bootstrap percentile summaries only for variable-geometry conditions; fixed-geometry repeats are reported as repeated trials without instance-generalization claims
